ctx.x: Keep Your Head to the Sky was before that and there was one before that.
When they still had Jessica Cleaves singing with them, right?

Right. Check you out. But the first one I bought was Open Our Eyes. I said, “Man there’s this band. You gotta hear it.” You know, where it was mostly for “Mighty Mighty.” That was the song that was on the radio. So I bought it. And my dad…. “May I see the record?” And my dad burst out laughing, he said, “Shit! That’s Maurice!” He starts laughing, “Awww! He made it. He made it.” And he said, “Yeah, I used to play….
